universe.name: Mythology
universe.description: First registered universe. A Reflexion-original roster inspired by public-domain Greek, Norse, and Egyptian mythology. Ports the structural category (pantheons, divine favor, myth-unit rosters as design space) — never any trademarked game's expression.

canon_rules.rule_notes: All encounters in this universe replay deterministically from receipts. Divine favor is modeled as an integer resource, never as hidden RNG.

species_templates.name: Stormcaller Scion
species_templates.description: Reflexion-original mortal lineage touched by sky and thunder; inspired by public-domain Greek mythic archetypes.

species_templates.name: Raven-Sworn
species_templates.description: Reflexion-original wanderers who trade memory for foresight; inspired by public-domain Norse mythic archetypes.

species_templates.name: Sun-Barge Warden
species_templates.description: Reflexion-original guardians of the measured passage of light; inspired by public-domain Egyptian mythic archetypes.

power_system.name: Divine Favor
power_system.description: Earned standing with the universe's mythic order, spent to fuel abilities. Earned only through play; never purchasable.

abilities.name: Thunderous Rebuke
abilities.description: A line of concussive force that punishes over-extension.

abilities.name: Omens of the Ninth Hour
abilities.description: Read the field; briefly sharpen an ally's anticipation.

abilities.name: Measured Dawn Aegis
abilities.description: Raise a warding light around the caster.

transformation_trees.name: Trial of the Broken Gate
transformation_trees.description: First-slice transformation tree: the path from mortal lineage to gatewarden.

factions.name: Concord of the High Storm
factions.description: Reflexion-original sky-order of oathkeepers; Greek-myth-inspired in structure only.

factions.name: The Pale Muster
factions.description: Reflexion-original host of oathbound wanderers; Norse-myth-inspired in structure only.

factions.name: Court of the Measured Sun
factions.description: Reflexion-original keepers of cycles and weighing; Egyptian-myth-inspired in structure only.

visual_audio_language.originality_note: All glyphs are drawn from Reflexion's original symbolic alphabet (semantic graph notation, geometric runes, dependency lines) per canon section 9.1 — no Matrix glyph design, coloration, typography, animation, or sound. Roster, art, audio, and text are Reflexion originals inspired by public-domain mythology per canon section 9.2 — no Age of Mythology names, art, audio, unit designs, UI, or text. Living traditions are represented with care per canon section 9.3.
